decision_rule: No interpretation below 0.90 confidence becomes binding without a follow-up owner decision.

funder_specific_timing.emergent_ventures: Prepare now; consider submission after bounded senior methodological feedback and meaningful interim pilot evidence.
funder_specific_timing.long_term_future_fund: Prepare now; consider submission after the complete 48-critique pilot, final agreement and operations analysis, and bounded senior feedback.
funder_specific_timing.manifund: Consider only after a clearly bounded public tranche and credible public evidence or endorsement exist.

pilot_start_semantics.gate_precedence: The previously approved production-path and pre-outreach gates remain mandatory. If they are not passed, the real-rating start date slips automatically rather than weakening the gates or treating calibration or rehearsal as research data.

pending_clarifications.reason_unresolved: The approved audience architecture requires one clearly dominant homepage audience. B/D does not establish whether AI-safety and AI-evaluation researchers are primary with general philosophy users secondary, the reverse, or genuinely co-primary.
pending_clarifications.recommended_resolution: Use AI-safety and AI-evaluation researchers as the primary homepage audience and general philosophy users as the principal secondary audience.

pending_clarifications.reason_unresolved: The payer reports both US and China payment-account countries and three available rails. Readiness still requires the exact originating account jurisdiction and a recipient-specific rail rule, together with payer and recipient compliance review.
pending_clarifications.recommended_resolution: Use a US-held account as the default origin because funds are reported as sent from the US; use ACH or domestic bank transfer for US recipients, Wise for supported cross-border transfers, and PayPal only as a fallback or recipient preference. Keep the China-held account outside the pilot unless separately required and reviewed.

immediate_engineering_priority: Complete and verify the authenticated staging rater journey and all production-path pre-outreach gates before any real research rating or rater invitation.
